links.outcome: Retrieval performance on Pashto inflected terms, transliterated drug names, and dialect variants versus English keyword baseline
links.effect: Baseline English keyword search returned zero results for Pashto input; the morphology-aware MARS retrieval achieved substantial recall (no exact figures in abstract).
links.quote: Evaluation on a benchmark of 50 Pashto medical queries across three categories (inflected terms, transliterated drug names, dialect variants) shows that MARS achieves substantial retrieval recall where the baseline English keyword search returns zero results for Pashto input.

unlisted_practices: Rule-based morphological stemming and script normalization for low-resource language medical retrieval
Morphology-aware retrieval scoring combined with local offline knowledge base for RAG
Proposed Clinical Safety Scale for systematic evaluation

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks an NLP/RAG system (Pharmaciest, using Gemma models and morphological processing) for Pashto medical drug information. Although it introduces retrieval tools and proposes an evaluation scale, it evaluates a novel system on a benchmark rather than testing an organizational deployment practice or operational guardrail.
